name: Munster Technological University
summary: Technological university in Cork and Kerry: about 70 honours degrees via CAO, from Engineering and Software Development to Fine Art at MTU Crawford.

ib.text: Six subjects with Maths and English (or Irish); no third language. Strictest: several BEng degrees HL Maths 5; Software Development Maths SL 6 or HL 3; Biomedical Science HL 5 in a lab science.

notes: Art and design courses at MTU Crawford, such as Fine Art (MT821), are restricted: list them by 1 February, and you are invited to submit a portfolio in March.
Mechanical and Manufacturing Engineering (MT834) weighs a digital portfolio equally with your CAO points.
